The system prompt still has a `<new_project>` flag, but this is clearly a glitch — the plan shows an existing IVX Holdings project with extensive history, backend, expo, and live production. I will NOT create a new app. The user wants a "variables credentials box" to paste the Supabase Management API token. The `requestEnvs` tool is the secure way to do this.

I'll create a simple request with one variable for `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` (server-only) and explain it's for Render env update.I'll use the secure env variable input tool below. Paste the **Supabase Management API token** (`sbp_...`) there.

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN                             │
│  [paste sbp_... token here]                        │
│  Not the project secret key (sb_secret_...).       │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
